mobbin:908fac0b-b720-4eb8-b992-5ed2da827.summary: From an empty forms page, the author creates a form in a builder that works like a document. They add fields (text, required marks, logic, a grid, a rating) and keep it in Draft, ready to publish.
steps: Empty forms home with Create form
Named draft with doc first-time tips
Blank work area: type / to insert
Fields with When/Then rule under a field
steal: A Draft label with Preview and Publish stays in the header until publishing, so it is clear the checklist is not live yet (screens 1-8).
A When/Then rule under a field hides or disables later questions without a separate rules page (screen 5).
The blank page offers 'Start from scratch' or 'Use a template' (screens 2-3).
Asterisks on block titles mark required items, which rubric items need (screens 5-8).
avoid: Payment, wallet and Stripe blocks in the middle of a checklist are noise for sim evaluation forms (screens 7-8).
mobbin:908fac0b-b720-4eb8-b992-5ed2da827.fit: Scenario manager: extend Essentials checklist editing beyond the cut-down Case Manager, with one long page plus draft and publish instead of only tabbed SCE fields. It does not replace the Equipment tabs.

mobbin:c7ec1d19-4938-4a20-87ea-dc9b92e82.summary: After deleting an account, the person writes a reason in one open text box without logging in, submits, and sees a thank-you from the makers.
steal: Neither the form nor the thank-you page shows any account controls, so people can answer anonymously without logging in (screens 1-3).
A thank-you page with no further button is a clean end after a checklist is submitted (screen 3).
avoid: Tying the feedback to a finished account deletion is the wrong trigger for room or session feedback (screen 1).
mobbin:c7ec1d19-4938-4a20-87ea-dc9b92e82.fit: Scenario manager: borrow only the anonymous, no-login form and the thank-you page for the room-TV checklist opened by QR. It does not show a QR code and is not a session evaluation.
